mapper.select: SELECT i.*, p.material_id AS mapped_material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name FROM ch_wx_order_item i LEFT JOIN ch_wx_product p ON p.shop_id = #{shopId} AND p.product_id = i.product_id AND p.sku_id = i.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = COALESCE(i.material_id, p.material_id) WHERE i.wx_order_id = #{wxOrderId} ORDER BY i.id
